name: delivery-conductor
description: Drives a stated need from the prompt to a ready PR/MR with no intervention: it opens the need on its own branch, then at every Stop sequences its siblings' stages (commit, gate, proven repros, fresh-eyes review, push and PR/MR, CI) through their read-only stage CLIs, runs the short script steps itself, and hands the model only the judgment steps. While it drives a branch, every sibling stands down (one voice). A halt, a no-progress stall or an exhausted budget blocks the need and holds its branch until the user resumes, abandons or releases it. Follows the AUTO scope; state in .git, never committed.
